sermon.title: Another Change of Government
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer traces Judah’s move from the corrupt rule of Jehoiakim to captivity under pagan Babylon, warned of in Leviticus 26. Through Jeremiah, God told the captives to build homes, raise families, seek the city’s peace and reject false prophets. Daniel and his friends were made ten times better and moved pagan kings to honor God. Daniel 11–12 promises people of understanding who instruct many before the end.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: Daniel 3:28 spoken as “Daniel 838”; Daniel 1:1 spoken as “Daniel 11”; captivity dated 607 BC; “193 years” and “nine hundred years” intervals; captives 10,000 about 15% of population; Jewish Encyclopedia claims (incest, murder, tattoos, reversed circumcision) about Jehoiakim; Reagan quote on the poor; the Spirit telling him “watch the church”. Sensitive content kept as spoken: God chose successful people, not beggars or the poor; “too much focus on the poor”; American Christians “in captivity” for 30 years; homosexuality-sin statements taken off TV; homosexuality, pedophilia and bestiality listed; welfare without work wrong; Jesus-only/Trinity/Mormon references.

faqs.question: Why does God punish a whole nation for a corrupt government?
faqs.answer: He says because the people did not stand up against it.

faqs.question: What is God’s correction meant to do?
faqs.answer: To change his people, like a father, not to over-punish.

faqs.question: Should believers pray for the city that mistreats them?
faqs.answer: Yes, seek its peace and pray for it.

faqs.question: Do you have to be perfect to be used of God?
Do science and the Bible conflict?
faqs.answer: He says good science and the Bible never conflict.

faqs.question: Do we worship prayer or worship itself?
faqs.answer: No, we worship God with them.

faqs.question: Where should you look to understand the end times?
Did Daniel understand the vision?
faqs.answer: No, it was sealed till the end.
